result.brief: 提出分解式分级视觉验证器，将复杂提示与环境规则拆解为子问题并给出连续打分，结合解耦强化学习训练，用于规则约束的生成式世界建模（迷宫、数独）与文生图评价。
result.reason: Builds a graded multimodal verifier for rule-governed generative world modeling (Maze, Sudoku), with RL training and pairwise critique theory; touches world-model verification rather than representation learning.
